stages.name: exact-source-preflight
acceptance: Resolve every required pin before execution.
Refuse floating Transformers main, floating model revisions, missing topology identity, or dirty tracked source.
Record upstream evidence only as UPSTREAM_REPORTED_NOT_SZL_MEASURED.

stages.name: single-device-reference
acceptance: Use fixed synthetic MoE inputs or a fixed public non-secret small MoE checkpoint.
Record loss and per-parameter gradient digests for router, non-expert and expert parameter classes.
Run at least two optimizer steps and fail on any NaN or Inf loss, gradient, parameter or optimizer state.

stages.name: expert-parallel-reference
acceptance: Bind expert ownership and token routing for each rank.
Prove grouped-GEMM sentinel-tail rows cannot leak uninitialized NaN or Inf values into backward.
Compare router, non-expert and expert gradients to S1 within declared numerical tolerances.

stages.name: fsdp2-plus-expert-parallel
acceptance: Use a named two-dimensional fsdp/tp device mesh with world_size equal to fsdp_size times tp_size.
Prove router-score gradient all-reduce semantics and remote-expert contribution recovery.
Prove per-mesh total-gradient-norm calculation and mesh-specific optimizer parameter groups.
Reject pipeline-parallel composition with tp/fsdp exactly as the pinned upstream source requires.

stages.name: save-gather-reload
acceptance: Run collective save_pretrained state-dict gather on the admitted topology.
Read back immutable bytes and reload them into the documented supported topology.
Do not claim optimizer checkpoint resumability where the upstream source explicitly refuses it.

stages.name: failure-and-rollback
acceptance: Exercise rank loss, collective timeout, malformed mesh, OOM and cancellation.
Emit explicit failure receipts; partial completion is not PASS.
Verify rollback to the previously admitted training path without changing production defaults.

stages.name: same-hardware-performance
acceptance: Measure only after all correctness and failure gates pass.
Compare step latency, throughput and peak memory on identical hardware, model, batch and sequence settings.
Never convert a speed result into model quality or production qualification.

claimBoundary: This preparation defines evidence requirements only. No FSDP2 plus Expert Parallel training run, model quality result, performance result, production readiness claim, publication, or promotion is created by this file.
